[aaa]
| radius enable on
| radius primary 10.0.0.42
* radius primary-secret lab-secret-0123456789abcdef
| radius fallback-timer 3
| radius fallback-local on-all-failures
| radius retries 3
| radius port 1812
| radius accounting-port 1813
| radius onetime-auth off
| radius default-access on
| radius debug off
[roles] not rendered
[mgmt-acl]
| iptables -A INPUT -i lo -j ACCEPT
| iptables -A INPUT -m conntrack --ctstate ESTABLISHED,RELATED -j ACCEPT
| iptables -A INPUT -p tcp -s 10.0.0.42/32 --dport 22 -j ACCEPT
| iptables -A INPUT -p tcp -s 10.0.0.42/32 --dport 443 -j ACCEPT
| iptables -A INPUT -p tcp -s 198.51.100.0/24 --dport 22 -j ACCEPT
| iptables -A INPUT -p tcp -s 198.51.100.0/24 --dport 443 -j ACCEPT
| iptables -A INPUT -p tcp -s 192.0.2.0/24 --dport 22 -j ACCEPT
| iptables -A INPUT -p tcp -s 192.0.2.0/24 --dport 443 -j ACCEPT
| iptables -A INPUT -p udp -s 10.0.0.42/32 --dport 161 -j ACCEPT
| iptables -A INPUT -p udp -s 198.51.100.0/24 --dport 161 -j ACCEPT
| iptables -A INPUT -i eth0 -s 10.0.0.42/32 -p icmp -j ACCEPT
| iptables -A INPUT -i eth0 -s 198.51.100.0/24 -p icmp -j ACCEPT
| iptables -A INPUT -i eth0 -s 192.0.2.0/24 -p icmp -j ACCEPT
[snmp]
| snmp enable on
| snmp version v1-v2-only
| snmp read-only yes
| snmp contact "NOC <noc@example.net>"
| snmp location "Rack 4, DC1"
* snmp ro-community lab-ro-community
[netconf] not rendered
[breakglass]
| user lab-admin level administrator
* user lab-admin password <PASSWORD>
| user lab-ops level user
* user lab-ops password <PASSWORD>
| user lab-ro level viewonly
* user lab-ro password <PASSWORD>
